title: CI harness for INT8 post-training calibration and regression tests
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a reproducible CI pipeline that generates, validates, and stores 8-bit post-training weight-only quantization profiles (GPTQ and AWQ variants) and runs automated regression checks against golden prompts and metric thresholds. The harness should create canonical calibration artifacts, compare accuracy metrics to a baseline FP16 run, and gate merges/rollouts with a deterministic accuracy guard. This ticket covers orchestration, storage schema, CI jobs, and failure/rollback rules; model onboarding and dataset selection are covered separately.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline creates a calibration profile artifact for a sample set of models (llama-13b, mixtral-8x) using both GPTQ and AWQ within CI
Each profile is accompanied by metadata: model_name, model_hash, sequence_length_distribution, calibration_seed, calibration_dataset, quant_backend
Automated accuracy check runs compare candidate profile generation against FP16 baseline and fail the job if delta exceeds thresholds (see metrics_and_thresholds)
Profiles are uploaded to s3://redwood-quant-profiles/{model}/{semver}/{profile-id}.json with immutable versioning and manifest entry
A deterministic rerun (same seed + dataset) reproduces generation within acceptable variance
Merge gating: PRs touching quantization CI or profile code cannot merge if accuracy guard fails; alerts surface to #infra-quant and assigned owner
implementation_plan: Stage 1: Create lightweight CI job (ci/quant/profile-gen) that runs GPTQ and AWQ profile generation for a single model and dataset; limit execution time and capture logs
Stage 2: Define and implement profile JSON schema and S3 layout; add manifest service integration
Stage 3: Implement accuracy-validator step which runs generation tasks on golden prompt set and calculates metrics vs FP16 baseline
Stage 4: Wire job into GitHub Actions and internal circleci pool with a dedicated GPU label; add resource tags and timeouts
Stage 5: Add canary pipeline to run nightly full-suite against small curated model set; surface trends to Console dashboard
Stage 6: Implement PR gating and Slack alerts with run artifacts and diff links
test_plan: Unit tests for profile schema validation and manifest update (python pytest)
Integration test that runs profile generation container on a small checkpoint (toy-1B) in CI emulating GPTQ/AWQ flow
Determinism test: rerun profile generation twice in CI with fixed seed and assert binary similarity threshold
Regression test: run golden prompts on candidate profile and compare metrics to stored FP16 baseline snapshot
Load test: ensure profile upload + manifest append handles concurrent runs (10 parallel) without race conditions
rollout_plan: Soft launch: enable PR gating for a single repo (models/legacy-approx) for 1 week
Monitor nightly canary for 3 days; if no fails and metric drift < threshold, expand to all model repos
If a profile generation job fails the accuracy gate during rollout, automatically block merge and create an incident ticket with artifacts
Provide an opt-out label (no-quant-ci) for heavy experimental branches during initial rollout
metrics_and_thresholds: ROUGE-L on summarization prompts: drop <= 2.0 points absolute
Exact-match on structured completion tests: drop <= 1.5% absolute
Embedding cosine similarity (avg across prompts) >= 0.985 of baseline
Determinism: bitwise-identical or floating-delta within 1e-5 for re-run of profile generation artifacts
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: AWQ/GPTQ non-determinism across kernels -> Mitigation: pin kernels and seeds, capture environment (cuda, driver, torch) in profile metadata
Risk: CI runtime cost -> Mitigation: use reduced calibration set in PRs, run full calibration nightly, cache intermediate tensors
Risk: false positives due to dataset noise -> Mitigation: use curated golden prompt set and bootstrap confidence intervals
Risk: profile format changes break consumers -> Mitigation: maintain backward compatibility and schema version field, add migrator script
